name: incident-summary
description: Turn incident timelines, remediation pull requests, impact evidence, and follow-up actions into an operational incident summary for technical or leadership audiences. Do not use for routine release notes or code review.

name: release-notes
description: Generate customer-facing release notes from a real Git comparison, merged pull requests, and available verification evidence. Flag breaking changes and missing evidence, and exclude internal-only refactors. Do not use for incident summaries or general change explanations.

name: security-review
description: Review a concrete code change for exploitable security defects, unsafe authorization boundaries, secret exposure, injection, and security-relevant accessibility regressions. Use when a diff, branch, or pull request needs evidence-backed security findings. Do not use for conceptual security explanations without code.
